message.content: {"findings":[{"cwe":"CWE-22","class":"Expand","method":"expandFile","explanation":"The method obtains an attacker-controlled archive entry name from ZipEntry.getName() and passes it directly to extractFile without rejecting path traversal sequences such as '../' or otherwise validating the entry name before it is used as a filesystem path."},{"cwe":"CWE-22","class":"Expand","method":"extractFile","explanation":"The method takes the tainted entryName, resolves it against the destination directory via FileUtils.resolveFile, and then uses new FileOutputStream(f) without checking that the resolved File remains inside the destination directory (for example by canonical-path containment), allowing archive entry names to escape the extraction directory."}]}
